# Glitter in Third

> A comprehensive resource hub for elementary teachers (grades 2-5) offering lesson plans, classroom activities, and educational products aligned with standards-based instruction and Science of Reading principles.

Created by Kelly Chapman, Glitter in Third provides both free and premium teacher resources focused on third-grade instruction across ELA, science, social studies, and economics. The site combines blog posts on modern teaching methodologies with a curated shop of classroom materials and a free resource library.

## Key Topics

- Third-grade teaching
- Elementary education
- Science of Reading
- Structured literacy
- Classroom activities
- Lesson planning
- Virginia SOLs standards
- Teacher resources
- Cognitive Load Theory

- Teachers Pay Teachers
- Classroom efficiency
- Kelly Chapman
- Educational blog
- Teacher community

## Core Resources & Shop

- [Shop - Glitter in Third](https://glitterinthird.com/shop): Shop for educational products and classroom materials for grades 2-5.
- [Glitter in Third Free Resource Library](https://glitterinthird.com/free-resource-library): Free resource library with password-protected educational materials.
- [Learn more about me, Kelly Chapman! - Glitter in Third](https://glitterinthird.com/about-me): About Kelly Chapman, founder of Glitter in Third and teacher resources.

## Reading & Literacy Instruction

- [What Does a Structured Literacy Reading Block Actually Look Like?](https://glitterinthird.com/2025/07/what-does-a-structured-literacy-reading-block-actually-look-like.html): Guide to structured literacy reading blocks using Science of Reading.
- [Spring Reading Worksheets to Improve Comprehension](https://glitterinthird.com/2023/01/spring-reading-comprehension-worksheets.html): Spring reading comprehension worksheets for elementary ELA instruction.

## Science Curriculum & Standards

- [Breaking Down the 2018 Virginia SOLs for 3rd Grade Science](https://glitterinthird.com/2025/07/breaking-down-the-2018-virginia-sols-for-3rd-grade-science.html): Guide to Virginia SOLs for 3rd grade science standards and activities.
- [How to Teach Life Cycles Activities and Lessons](https://glitterinthird.com/2021/10/life-cycles-activities-lessons.html): Life cycles activities and lessons for elementary science curriculum.

## Social Studies & Economics

- [What's New in the 2023 Virginia Social Studies Standards—and How to Make Them Stick in 3rd Grade](https://glitterinthird.com/2025/07/whats-new-in-the-2023-virginia-social-studies-standards-and-how-to-make-them-stick-in-3rd-grade.html): 2023 Virginia social studies standards guide for 3rd grade instruction.
- [3rd grade Economics Activities You'll LOVE](https://glitterinthird.com/2021/03/3rd-grade-economics-activities-kids.html): Third grade economics activities and interactive lesson resources.

## Teaching Methodology & Pedagogy

- [What Is Cognitive Load Theory—and Why Should Classroom Teachers Care?](https://glitterinthird.com/2025/07/cognitive-load-theory-classroom-2.html): Cognitive Load Theory explained for classroom lesson planning and design.
